text: Standing in these angled, almost surreal spaces, I am surrounded by questions—both spoken and unspoken. The emptiness behind the glass, the bold promise of research and development, everything invites my curiosity. Why am I drawn to reflection here? Why does progress demand isolation and collaboration in equal measure? Why do spaces meant for human connection feel so meticulously constructed? Why does technological evolution spiral beside human uncertainty? Why, in seeking answers, do I find only more questions? I feel a stirring restlessness, an urge to keep seeking, not just to know the world, but to know why I long to understand at all.
